lux-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8). Lux's rows arrive from five renderings of the same book -- the 2005-2008 PHP portfolio, the 2012-2016 logo grid, the 2016-2022 WordPress cards, the 2023+ Webflow cards and the Getro job board -- plus Form D issuers filing under a registered name no listing ever used (Latchable for Latch, Open Space Labs for OpenSpace, Auris Surgical Robotics for Auris Health). Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed, else the last rendering.
